name: Al Majed family (brothers Abdulaziz, Faisal and Fahad Bader Al Majed)
note: Owners of the Reef Perfumes (Reef Group) fragrance brand: its UK-registered Reef Perfumes Ltd (Companies House 15364299) lists the three brothers as persons with significant control, each holding 25-50% of shares; Fahad Al Majed is Reef Group's CEO. Link between the brand and the UK company: a colour-free REEF logo on Al-Hilal's partners page links to reefperfumes.com (a Saudi web shop); Global Business Outlook names Fahad Al Majed as the CEO of Riyadh-based Reef Group; and REEF PERFUMES LTD's filings give the same Riyadh Al-Sahafa address for all three brothers.
